name: Iso-Surface Ray-Casting
definition: A variant of GPU-based ray-casting to render illuminated surfaces, where traversal is back-to-front within each pass to find the closest intersection point, followed by gradient lookup and lighting.
summary: Iso-Surface Ray-Casting renders opaque isosurfaces by using back-to-front traversal to find the closest intersection, differing from standard volume ray casting by terminating rays early and shading only at that hit point.
